items.description: The service layer raises a validation error for a negative quantity before any database write is attempted
Given an operator files a stock record with a quantity below zero, then the filing is rejected with a response message that names the quantity field
Given an operator files a stock record with a quantity below zero, then no record is created or changed in the store
The real branch database enforces CHECK quantity >= 0 so that inserting a row with a negative quantity raises a constraint violation
Given an operator posts a filing request with an invalid field value, the API response body contains a message that identifies the specific offending field by name
